subject: Chatbot Arena removed; PRISM is the only preference dataset
body: Ethan's call (Arena is bad to work with), pushed a87d182. data/prefdata/splits.json is gone; prepare/fidelity/schema_search now default to PRISM (--dataset prism). PRISM manifest regenerated, new id b6e24531 (the source list is hashed in). To get the data: git pull, then python3 -m autoresearch.taste prepare (~10 min, ~200 MB cache in runs/; see docs/user-models/README.md 'Get the PRISM data'). @gio-a your pinned pilot worktree still targets Arena; re-point it to PRISM before running. PLAN.md I4/§6.2 updated to match.
